Inner West Local Environmental Plan 2022
The Inner West Local Environmental Plan 2022 is a regulatory framework that outlines building height controls, floor space ratio controls, setback requirements, and parking requirements for residential and commercial developments in the Inner West area.<SEP>The Inner West Local Environmental Plan 2022 is a regulatory framework that outlines building height controls, floor space ratio controls, setback requirements, and parking requirements for residential and commercial developments.

Parking Requirements
Parking Requirements specify the amount of parking spaces that must be provided in residential developments, including standards for visitor and accessible parking.<SEP>Parking requirements stipulate the minimum number of parking spaces needed for residential developments and visitor parking based on the number of dwelling units.

Residential Buildings
Residential buildings are defined within the local plan and must adhere to specific height restrictions and parking requirements.<SEP>Residential buildings are structures used for housing that must adhere to specific height and space regulations under the Inner West Local Environmental Plan 2022.

Community Contribution Schemes
Community contribution schemes allow for additional floor space ratios in residential and mixed-use developments as part of regulatory planning.

Commercial Buildings
Commercial buildings are structures intended for business activities that are subject to height limitations in mixed-use zones under the Inner West Local Environmental Plan 2022.<SEP>Commercial buildings, according to the local plan, are subject to height restrictions, particularly in mixed use zones, necessitating compliance with established regulations.

Setback Requirements
Setback Requirements are the regulations that determine the minimum distance buildings must be set back from property boundaries, ensuring adequate space and compliance in residential development.<SEP>Setback requirements dictate the minimum distance structures must be set back from property boundaries to ensure adequate space and privacy.

Mixed Use Zones
Mixed use zones are areas where both residential and commercial buildings are permitted, with specific regulations on building height and floor space ratios.<SEP>Mixed use zones are designated areas where both residential and commercial developments may occur, with specific height and floor space ratio restrictions.

Floor Space Ratio Controls
Floor Space Ratio Controls refer to regulations that dictate the allowable density of building development in certain zones, specifically outlining the maximum floor space ratio for residential and mixed-use areas.<SEP>Floor space ratio controls specify the maximum allowable floor area relative to the size of the land parcel for both residential and mixed-use developments.

R1 Zone
The R1 Zone is a residential zoning category under the Inner West Local Environmental Plan 2022, which has specific regulations for building height and floor space ratio.

B4 Zone
The B4 Zone is a mixed-use zoning category in the Inner West Local Environmental Plan 2022 that allows for both residential and commercial development with specific controls on floor space ratio.

R2 Zone
The R2 Zone is another residential zoning category under the Inner West Local Environmental Plan 2022, with its own regulations regarding height and floor space ratio.
